description:
You have an unformatted tenant notification letter open in LibreOffice Writer at /home/ga/Documents/tenant_notice_draft.docx. Reformat it as a standard full-block business letter with the following requirements:

1. Set ALL text in the document to Liberation Serif (or Times New Roman) at 12pt.
2. Set all four page margins (top, bottom, left, right) to 1.0 inch.
3. Apply the built-in 'Heading 1' paragraph style to the first line containing the company name 'Meridian Property Group, LLC'.
4. Make the entire 'Re:' subject line bold (the paragraph starting with 'Re: Notice of HVAC...').
5. Make the signer's name 'Jonathan R. Whitfield' bold.
6. Set paragraph spacing: Add 12pt of space after each body paragraph (the text between the salutation and the closing).
7. Keep all original text content intact.

Save the formatted document as a new file at /home/ga/Documents/tenant_notice_final.docx (DOCX format).
